translations.en: I believe in God, the Father almighty, creator of heaven and earth. I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the Virgin Mary. He suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried. He descended to the dead. On the third day he rose again. He ascended into heaven and is seated at the right hand of the Father. He will come again to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and the life everlasting. Amen.
The Rosary has 20 mysteries, grouped into four sets of five. Traditionally you pray one set per session. While praying each decade, meditate on one mystery rather than merely reciting words.
Joyful Mysteries
The Incarnation—the Son of God becoming man—and Jesus' hidden childhood. Monday and Saturday.
The Annunciation
1. The Annunciation.

Luke 1.26-38. Verse 35: And the angel said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore the child to be born will be called holy, the Son of God."
The Visitation
2. The Visitation.

Luke 1.39-56. Verses 41-43: And when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit and she exclaimed with a loud cry, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb! And why is this granted me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?"
The Birth of Jesus
3. The Birth of Jesus.
Luke 2.1-20. Verse 7: And she gave birth to her first-born son and wrapped him in swaddling cloths, and laid him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the inn.
The Presentation of Jesus at the Temple

prayers.title: 4. The Presentation of Jesus at the Temple.

translations.en: 4. The Presentation of Jesus at the Temple.

prayers.title: 4. The Presentation of Jesus at the Temple.

translations.en: Luke 2.21-38. Verses 28-32: Simeon took him up in his arms and blessed God and said, "Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word; for mine eyes have seen thy salvation which thou hast prepared in the presence of all peoples, a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to thy people Israel."
Finding Jesus in the Temple
5. Finding Jesus in the Temple.

Luke 2.41-52. Verses 45-47: and when they did not find him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking him. After three days they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions; and all who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
Luminous Mysteries
Mysteries of Light
Jesus' public ministry, when He reveals the Kingdom of God and manifests Himself as the light of the world. Thursday.
The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan

prayers.title: The First Luminous Mystery: The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan

translations.en: The First Luminous Mystery: The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan

prayers.title: The First Luminous Mystery: The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan

translations.en:
The heavens open, the Holy Spirit descends upon Jesus, and the Father declares Him to be the beloved Son.

Meditation points: Jesus' identity and the beginning of His public mission
The Wedding at Cana

prayers.title: The Second Luminous Mystery: The Wedding at Cana

translations.en: The Second Luminous Mystery: The Wedding at Cana

prayers.title: The Second Luminous Mystery: The Wedding at Cana

translations.en:
Jesus changes water into wine, His first public sign. Through Mary's intervention, the disciples are led to faith.

Meditation points: Trust in Christ's power and confidence in Mary's intercession
The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God

prayers.title: The Third Luminous Mystery: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God

translations.en: The Third Luminous Mystery: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God

prayers.title: The Third Luminous Mystery: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God

translations.en:
Jesus announces that God's Kingdom is near and calls people to conversion. He also forgives sins.

Meditation points: Examine your life, repent sincerely, and receive Christ's mercy
The Transfiguration

prayers.title: The Fourth Luminous Mystery: The Transfiguration

translations.en: The Fourth Luminous Mystery: The Transfiguration

prayers.title: The Fourth Luminous Mystery: The Transfiguration

translations.en:
Jesus' divine glory shines forth before Peter, James, and John.

Meditation points: Strengthened faith in Christ; points toward His Passion and Resurrection
The Institution of the Eucharist

prayers.title: The Fifth Luminous Mystery: The Institution of the Eucharist

translations.en: The Fifth Luminous Mystery: The Institution of the Eucharist

prayers.title: The Fifth Luminous Mystery: The Institution of the Eucharist

translations.en:
At the Last Supper, Jesus gives Himself to the Church in the Eucharist.

Meditation points: Christ's sacrificial love and the Eucharist as the sacramental expression of His Paschal Mystery
Sorrowful Mysteries
Christ's Passion and death, through which He reveals God's love and accomplishes our salvation. Tuesday and Friday; also Sunday in Advent and Lent.
The Agony in the Garden
1. The Agony in the Garden.

Lk 22.39-46. Verses 41-42,44: And he withdrew from them about a stone's throw, and knelt down and prayed, "Father, if thou art willing, remove this cup from me; nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done." And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him. And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became like great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
The Scourging at the Pillar
2. The Scourging at the Pillar.
Mt 27.15-26. Verse 26: Then Pilate released for them Barab'bas, and having scourged Jesus, delivered him to be crucified.
The Crowning with Thorns
3. The Crowning with Thorns.

Mt 27.27-31. Verses 29-30: And they stripped him and put a scarlet robe upon him, and plaiting a crown of thorns they put it on his head, and put a reed in his right hand. And kneeling before him they mocked him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!" And they spat upon him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
The Carrying of the Cross
4. The Carrying of the Cross.
Jn 19.16-17: Then he handed him over to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus, and he went out, bearing his own cross, to the place called the place of a skull, which is called in Hebrew Golgotha.
The Crucifixion
5. The Crucifixion.

Lk 23.33-49. Verses 44-46: It was now about the sixth hour, and there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour, while the sun's light failed; and the curtain of the temple was torn in two. Then Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, "Father, into thy hands I commit my spirit!" And having said this he breathed his last.
Glorious Mysteries
Christ's victory over sin and death and Mary's participation in His glory. Wednesday and Sunday (except Advent and Lent).
The Resurrection

prayers.title: The First Glorious Mystery: The Resurrection

translations.en: The First Glorious Mystery: The Resurrection

prayers.title: The First Glorious Mystery: The Resurrection

translations.en:
Jesus rises from the dead. His Resurrection is the foundation of Christian hope and shows that death and sin do not have the final word.

Meditation points: Christian hope; death and sin do not have the final word
The Ascension

prayers.title: The Second Glorious Mystery: The Ascension

translations.en: The Second Glorious Mystery: The Ascension

prayers.title: The Second Glorious Mystery: The Ascension

translations.en:
The risen Christ ascends into heaven. This mystery points to Jesus' glorification and reminds us that human life is ultimately directed toward union with God.

Meditation points: Jesus' glorification; human life directed toward union with God
The Descent of the Holy Spirit

prayers.title: The Third Glorious Mystery: The Descent of the Holy Spirit

translations.en: The Third Glorious Mystery: The Descent of the Holy Spirit

prayers.title: The Third Glorious Mystery: The Descent of the Holy Spirit

translations.en:
The Holy Spirit comes upon the Apostles at Pentecost. They are strengthened to proclaim the Gospel, and the Church is empowered for its mission.

Meditation points: Strength to proclaim the Gospel; the Church empowered for its mission
The Assumption of Mary

prayers.title: The Fourth Glorious Mystery: The Assumption of Mary

translations.en: The Fourth Glorious Mystery: The Assumption of Mary

prayers.title: The Fourth Glorious Mystery: The Assumption of Mary

translations.en:
Mary is taken body and soul into heavenly glory. This mystery points to the destiny God promises His faithful people: resurrection and eternal life.

Meditation points: The destiny God promises His faithful people; resurrection and eternal life
The Coronation of Mary

prayers.title: The Fifth Glorious Mystery: The Coronation of Mary

translations.en: The Fifth Glorious Mystery: The Coronation of Mary

prayers.title: The Fifth Glorious Mystery: The Coronation of Mary

translations.en:
Mary is honored as Queen of Heaven. Her glory is entirely connected to Christ and shows the fulfillment awaiting those who remain faithful to God.

Meditation points: Fulfillment awaiting those who remain faithful to God
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, and lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Your Mercy.
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name; thy kingdom come; thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

prayers.title: For the increase of Faith, Hope, and Charity

translations.en: For the increase of Faith, then Hope, then Charity.

Hail, Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope! To you we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to you we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, O most gracious advocate, your eyes of mercy toward us, and after this our exile, show us to the blessed fruit of your womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Let us pray. O God, whose only begotten Son, by his life, death, and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life, grant, we beseech you, that meditating upon these mysteries of the most holy rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise, Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel

translations.en: St. Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle; be our safeguard against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray. And do you, O prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, cast into Hell Satan and all the evil spirits who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.
Saint Joseph, guardian of the Redeemer, protector of the Holy Family—pray for us. Amen.

Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary,
that never was it known
that anyone who fled to thy protection,
implored thy help,
or sought thy intercession,
was left unaided.

Inspired by this confidence,
I fly unto thee,
O Virgin of virgins, my mother;
to thee do I come,
before thee I stand,
sinful and sorrowful.

O Mother of the Word Incarnate,
despise not my petitions,
but in thy mercy hear and answer me.
Amen.

V. The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
R. And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

V. Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
R. Be it done unto me according to thy word.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

V. And the Word was made flesh.
R. And dwelt among us.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Let us pray:
Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, thy Son, was made known by the message of an angel, may by his Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of his Resurrection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

O my God, I am heartily sorry for having offended you, and I detest all my sins because of your just punishments, but most of all because they offend you, my God, who are all good and deserving of all my love. I firmly resolve, with the help of your grace, to sin no more and to avoid the near occasions of sin. Amen.

Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord,
and let perpetual light shine upon them.

May they rest in peace.
Amen.
